links.comparator_used: Default-knowledge prompting (and in-context prompting) without chain-of-thought
links.outcome: Accuracy of CRS resectability classification against expert consensus using EPOS 2020 criteria
links.effect: CoT significantly improved both models, with peak accuracies of 95.3% vs. 96.0% (p = 1.00) for GPT-5.5 vs. DeepSeek-V3. Default-knowledge accuracy was 72.7% for GPT-5.5 and 81.3% for DeepSeek-V3; in-context accuracy was 78.0% and 86.7%.
links.tradeoff: Subgroup analyses showed consistent CoT effects for GPT-5.5, but DeepSeek-V3 showed heterogeneous response patterns across subgroups.
links.quote: Notably, CoT prompting significantly improved both models, yielding comparable peak accuracies (95.3% vs. 96.0%, p = 1.00).
